correctness.rationale: The smoothness criterion, genus, differential basis and full Cartier coefficient matrix are reconstructed from F(x)^2 and F(x)^4. Exact polynomial-ring calculations establish the repeated Hasse factor and the rank-one block. Cohomological Frobenius has the transpose coefficient matrix, so the correct product B^[7]B yields P(b); P factors into the discriminant factor times eight irreducible cubics, with no common smoothness roots. Higher twists stay nonzero when the second twist is nonzero. Separate exact polynomial and exhaustive F7/F49/F343 programs pass; finite enumeration is only corroboration. The theorem excludes singular fibers and claims no Newton-polygon information.

value.rationale: The involution produces a natural ordinary elliptic quotient of a genus-four trigonal family. The result determines the entire a-number/p-rank stratification, identifies a twice-reduced nonordinary Hasse divisor and classifies the further 24-point semilinear rank drop in eight Frobenius orbits. This makes a meaningful distinction between Cartier rank and stable p-rank over a genuine two-parameter family; no arbitrary parameter truncation, isomorphism-class claim or unsupported general downstream theorem is needed.
